changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO breeds (name, specie_id, created_date, enabled, version, company_id, general) SELECT n.name, s.id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 1, 0, NULL, 1 FROM species s JOIN ( SELECT 'Mestizo' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 'Hurón Doméstico' ) n WHERE s.name = 'Hurón';
